notes:
Inbound from sign-up form — interested in hosted API for in-app support assistant. Early discovery call 2026-03-05 (Maya + Diego + Head of Ops).

Key ask: they need to understand how customer prompts and conversation logs are handled on hosted plan. Specific Qs:
- What is default log retention for request/response bodies? can it be shortened to 7/14/30 days?
- Is there an opt-out or anonymization flow for end-user prompts (prefer not to store PII)?
- Is there a delete-by-customer API / web UI to purge prompts/logs on demand?
- Are prompts used to train models or aggregated analytics on hosted tier? (they quoted: "We can't allow any training on customer content")
- Any guarantees around prompt storage in plaintext vs encrypted at rest? KMS support?

Summary of requirements: lightweight integration (JS SDK), low latency (<300ms median for single-turn support lookups), cost-sensitive (keeping token costs low), and strong defaults for privacy/retention. They are primarily public-cloud only (no VPC/on-prem request).

What we shared so far: link to hosted plan pricing + quickstart, security FAQ doc (drive links above), short draft retention policy (attached). They responded positively to privacy-first defaults but legal wants specific SLA for deletion and written confirmation that hosted tier does not use customer prompts for model training without opt-in.

Quotes/remarks:
- "We want 'privacy-by-default' for end users. If a user reports a bug and includes PII, we need to be able to remove it quickly."
- "If there's no deletion endpoint, this will be a hard no from compliance."

Tone/status: warm inbound, product fit looks good for SMB support assistant. Legal/compliance is main gating factor. AE to keep convo narrow — provide technical ops answers + product screenshots for retention settings.

Suggested collateral to send: one-page retention matrix (7/14/30/90 day options), sample opt-out API (curl examples), confirmation language for EULA/terms. Keep message short, emphasize hosted API privacy defaults.
